REPORT
Date May 31, 19 33.

Subject (in full) Illegal functioning by Chinese Police on Municipal
Roads in Hungjao Area

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by Thos Rubinstein, Supt.

Further to my report on May 26 on the above subject, I
understand from General Wen that he has warned his Inspectors
during a conference that more care should be excersied in the
search of motor cars and in the case of vehicles occupied by
foreigners, search should not be made unless special circumstances
warrant it.

Discreet enquiries however show that General Wen has
referred the matter to the Mayor who maintains that the Chinese
Police have the right to search cars in the region referred to.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Commr. of Police.
In formation.
Thos Rubinstein
O. i/c S. B.

报告
日期：1933年5月31日。

主题（全称） 中国警察在虹桥地区市政道路上非法执勤

呈报人：谭绍良警司 转呈人：鲁宾斯坦（Thos Rubinstein）警司

继我于5月26日就上述主题提交报告后，我从温将军处获悉，他在一次会议期间已警告其督察员，在搜查汽车时应更加谨慎；对于载有外国人的车辆，除非有特殊情形证明有必要，否则不应进行搜查。

然而，经审慎查访显示，温将军已将此事呈报市长，市长坚持认为中国警察在上述地区有权搜查汽车。

谭绍良
警司

特别分部主管警官。

警务处处长。
供阅知。
托马斯·鲁宾斯坦
特别分部主管警官

51/5.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE No. D A 5 4 3
S. 1, Special Branch Report
REPORT
Date May 26, 1933.

Subject (in full) illegal functioning by Chinese Police on
Municipal Roads in Hungjao Area
Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by Jno Robertson, Supt

I had an interview with General Wen Ung-en and
his Secretary Colonel Paul Lee at the Public Safety Bureau
at 11 a.m. May 26 and protested in a friendly manner against
the illegal functioning on Municipal Roads in the Hungjao
Area.

General Wen replied that the search parties were
functioning on instruction from the Municipality to put a
check on crime, especially kidnapping, and that cars were
being searched, irrespective of the fact whether the
occupants were foreigners or Chinese.

General Wen however promised to call a meeting
of the Inspectors of the 6th District to consider the
advisability of abandoning the search.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（左侧批注：Supt. Tan, For further report please. JRB）

Commissioner of Police,
Sir,

Information. Effort
will be made to ascertain what
transpires at the meeting
between General Wen and his Inspectors
and a further report will be submitted.
J. W. Owens
O. i/c Sp. Br. 20
May 26

报告
日期：1933年5月26日。

主题（全称） 中国警察在虹桥地区市政道路上非法执勤

呈报人：谭绍良警司 转呈人：罗伯逊（Jno Robertson）警司

我于5月26日上午11时在公安局会见了温应泉将军及其秘书保罗·李上校，并以友好方式对中国警察在虹桥地区市政道路上的非法执勤行为提出抗议。

温将军答复称，搜查队是根据市政府的指令开展行动，以遏制犯罪，特别是绑架案，并且无论车内乘客是外国人还是中国人，均对车辆进行搜查。

然而，温将军承诺将召集第六区督察员开会，审议是否放弃搜查措施。

谭绍良
警司

特别分部主管警官。

（左侧批注：谭警司，请提交进一步报告。JRB）

警务处处长，
阁下，

供阅知。我们将设法查明温将军与其督察员会议的情况，并将提交进一步报告。
J. W. 欧文斯
特别分部主管警官 5月26日
